settings.heading: Why marketplace brands plateau
settings.subcopy: Common barriers we see on first audits, and what we fix first.

settings.pain: Low visibility, products stuck on page two.
settings.answer: Keyword strategy, listing quality and indexation rebuilt around real search intent, not guesswork.

settings.pain: High ACOS with no clear bid strategy.
settings.answer: Campaigns structured around contribution profit, Sponsored Products, Brands and Display with weekly search-term hygiene.

settings.pain: Poor conversions, shoppers bounce to competitors.
settings.answer: Imagery, titles and A+ Content that answer objections in the order buyers raise them.

settings.pain: Lost Buy Box, suppressed listings, stockouts.
settings.answer: Catalog health, FBA planning and compliance recovery before we scale ad spend.
